Range Intelligent Computing.why: Invests in, builds, owns and operates campus-scale AI data centers (AIDC) in China and overseas, leasing wholesale IDC cabinets to internet and cloud majors and running its own AI compute clusters for AI-model customers, so AI compute build-out drives its capacity, revenue and capex.
Range Intelligent Computing.evidence: Range Intelligent Computing investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-23-2026): total planned computing-center scale about 6GW (about 5.4GW in China, about 600MW overseas), operating scale about 750MW at end-June 2026; its AIDC business builds self-owned intelligent computing clusters and provides compute services.

players.product: AIDC (AI data-center) campuses and AI compute services: nine AI infrastructure clusters (Langfang in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Pinghu, Foshan, Huizhou, Chongqing, Lanzhou, Danzhou; Sha Ling, Hong Kong; Batam, Indonesia), wholesale IDC cabinets for internet and cloud majors

quarterly_data.quarter: Range Intelligent Computing investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: its computing centers have a total planned scale of about 6GW (about 5.4GW in China, about 600MW overseas); operating scale was about 750MW at the end of June 2026, and within 2026 it expects to deliver more than 300MW in China and 60MW of overseas computing centers. Its strategy is AIDC compute business in China and IDC cabinet business overseas. Later capex has no fixed schedule: it depends mainly on how fast it wins firm long-cycle orders, the progress of power and energy-quota supply, and the cost-performance of the server hardware supply chain, while weighing cash-flow safety and debt structure.
quarterly_data.figure: ~6GW planned; ~750MW operating (end-June 2026); 2026 delivery 300MW+ in China and 60MW overseas expected

quarterly_data.quarter: Range Intelligent Computing investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: in 2025 it was the first to help a customer complete deployment of a domestic-chip supernode intelligent computing cluster at the hundred-kilowatt-per-cabinet class, moving resource supply from server level to cabinet and cross-cabinet level. In H1 2026 it kept iterating supernode-cluster liquid-cooling and control systems adapted to domestic chips (shared air/liquid cooling sources, air purification for harsh conditions, water-quality control, full-lifecycle liquid-cooling O&M) to solve compatibility pain points of domestic compute servers; the new-generation large-scale supernode clusters already deployed are running stably.

quarterly_data.quarter: Range Intelligent Computing investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: through earlier large-scale centralised purchasing it has built a stable compute-equipment supply chain covering servers, storage, optical modules, switches and cables, and says delivery speed and supply capability will strengthen further as the supply chain improves. Its AIDC business runs self-invested, self-built, self-owned and self-operated intelligent computing centers and also invests in high-performance servers and network equipment to build its own large-scale clusters and sell compute services. Since 2026 its customer structure has been further optimised; it has strategic cooperation with mainstream internet companies, cloud vendors and leading AI large-model companies (no customer named).

quarterly_data.quarter: Range Intelligent Computing investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company's view on SZSE Interactive Easy: the AI industry is shifting structurally from billing by compute to billing by token; computing centers are moving from compute providers to token producers, the core metric shifting from FLOPS to tokens per watt and billing possibly from resource-based to output-based. It said this model is very demanding for AI infrastructure providers, which need ample power, compute, funding and technical talent, and it believes its existing strengths will let it capture related opportunities.
